info.title: Beebot Sounds API
info.description: Sound catalog, comments, votes, web playback, soundboards and authenticated sound management. See beebot-sound-community.md for the frontend contract.

post.description: Accepts MP3 or Opus files up to 25 MiB. Guild membership and bot presence are required.

get.description: At least one nonblank q or tag is required.

errors.message: Private sound cannot be used in this context

get.summary: Read trending, latest and popular tags
Search the public catalog and optionally include own matches

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of the sound name or any of its tags.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Defaults to relevance with q, popular otherwise. Popular, mostLiked and mostDisliked sort by total plays, likes and dislikes, respectively, in descending order.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

get.summary: Suggest up to five sounds and three tags
Read a page of root comments or direct replies

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

get.summary: Get totals for a creator’s public sounds

post.summary: Record a playback with a retry-safe UUID
Create a comment or a reply

patch.summary: Edit text, pinned state or hearted state

delete.summary: Delete a comment and return the updated count

put.summary: Set or clear the authenticated user’s sound vote
Set or clear the authenticated user’s comment vote
Upload or replace a sound cover

file.description: PNG, JPEG or GIF, up to 1 MiB.

SoundDescription.description: Optional sound description. On write, null or blank clears the description.

durationMs.description: Persisted playback duration in milliseconds. Null when the row has no persisted duration.

retryAfter.description: Retry delay in seconds when available.

CommunityNotFound.description: Sound or comment not found or not visible
